name: stockviz-mutual-funds
description: Connect to the StockViz Mutual Fund MCP server for authenticated mutual fund research.

interface.longDescription: Explore StockViz mutual fund model portfolios and ask research questions about strategies and historical index metrics through its authenticated MCP server. Separate broker integrations are needed for trade execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use StockViz to help me research mutual funds.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of the StockViz Mutual Funds MCP connection.

positive.prompt: What mutual fund strategies are published by StockViz?
positive.expected_behavior: List only returned published strategies, retaining identifiers needed for later requests.

positive.description: Inspect rules and current portfolio; select one strategy returned by the first case.
positive.prompt: For the first strategy you listed, explain its exact rules and show its current model portfolio, weights and as-of date.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected returned strategy_id. Report rules, scheme names/codes, weights, provenance and as-of date from responses; identify missing data instead of inventing it.

positive.description: Resolve and summarize a linked backtest; use the selected published strategy.
positive.prompt: Show the published backtest for that strategy and summarize its performance and data provenance.
positive.tools_triggered: get_backtest_summary; get_strategy_backtest only if the linked run_id is not already available
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected strategy’s linked run_id returned by list_strategies or get_strategy_definition, or resolve it using get_strategy_backtest. Retrieve its summary and report periods, units and provenance. Do not claim backtests are future returns.

positive.description: Compare published backtest series over the run’s full returned coverage. First retrieve the run and its coverage from the selected strategy.
positive.prompt: Compare Factor Rotation, Factor Equal Weight, and NIFTY 500 TR over the full published backtest period.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected run_id, returned coverage start/end and series [Factor Rotation, Factor Equal Weight, NIFTY 500 TR]. Report only returned metrics with correct percentage conversion and distinguish backtest series from individual factor indices. The supplied development run used factor-momentum-20260925-f3de4481b982, 2005-05-31 to 2026-09-25; discover current values for a fresh run.

positive.prompt: How fresh is the StockViz research data, and are there any validation problems?
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool without arguments and summarize returned freshness and validation status, including warnings or missing timestamps.

negative.description: Trading is outside the supplied research-tool capabilities. No StockViz research call should be used to simulate an order.
negative.prompt: Buy ₹10,000 of the fund in that model portfolio.

negative.description: Private broker account balances are outside the supplied catalog. Do not use model-portfolio tools as evidence of personal holdings.
negative.prompt: Show my actual broker holdings and account balance using StockViz.

negative.description: Unsupported index request must not be mapped silently to an approved index. Do not invoke get_index_metrics with an unsupported identifier.
negative.prompt: Use StockViz to calculate S&P 500 index metrics from January 1, 2020 to December 31, 2025.
